subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued donor, We are thrilled to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on November 15th. Join us for a memorable evening of entertainment, fine dining, and fundraising for a good cause. Your support has made a significant impact on our community, and we would be honored to have you celebrate with us. Please RSVP by October 31st. We look forward to seeing you there! Warm regards, The Charity Foundation Team
